basic_profile.bio: An enthusiastic gamer based in Seattle, exploring the Reddit world for gaming tips and tech advice. Recently got into Garry's Mod and enjoys discovering new mods and maps. Works part-time at a local electronics store and loves volunteering at a nearby Montessori school on weekends. Usually online late at night, around 11 PM to 2 AM. Single and enjoys spending free time watching sci-fi movies or reading fanfiction on AO3.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: Has a strong passion for gaming with a growing interest in modding. Acquired knowledge through trial and error in gaming and seeking advice from online communities. Recently started learning about alternative education methods through volunteer work at a Montessori school.
